title: Origami Way — Easy Origami Car
selection_reason: Longer than the five-action fox: two reference folds and unfolds, wheel flaps, body fold, return fold, roof corner, and turnover. Published instructions use straight folds and ordinary unfolds; drawing windows is decoration and omitted from the fold-only replay.
scope: Pureland-style flat car; no squash, sink, reverse folds, cutting or glue required by the published folding sequence.
